newsitem.title: ESTONIA: VORU JUUST NEW ISSUE OVER-SUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: VORU JUUST NEW ISSUE OVER-SUBSCRIBED.

text.p: Cheese factory Voru Juust's 60,000 new share issue, which closed on August 6, was over-subscribed 2.86 times, Hansa Investments said on Thursday.
"There was good local interest in this issue," Tarmo Juristo, associate director of Hansa Investments, told Reuters.
The 10-kroon nominal shares were on offer for 133.35 kroons.
"From the size of the offers, the interest was mostly by institutional investors," he added.
The share issue put 10.7 percent of the cheese factory's shares in public hands.
Individual shareholders of the company plan to sell a further 14.3 percent to allow the company to meet stock exchange regulations for a listing on the Tallinn stock exchange.
